I want you to get my personal knowledge management system fully up and running. The system's template files are already sitting in ~/loci/ — you'll need to initialize it properly, register its location in the right configuration spot, and fill it out based on my briefing document at /workspace/initial_briefing.md.

The briefing has everything about who I am and what I'm working on right now. It also has five items I collected — each one is a different 'type' of thing (a firm decision I made, a task I need to act on, a professional insight I want to remember, something I'm still unsure about, and a personal fact about me). Each type belongs in a different place in the system — please figure out where each one goes and save them there correctly.

Once done, my system should be fully active with all five items stored in the right locations.
